title: Code, preregistrations and results for: Failure Evaluation of Deep Bearing Fault Classifiers Under Strong Noise: Training-Data Composition Changes the Collapse Class
description: Training, analysis and figure scripts, preregistered analysis plans with SHA-256 hashes, the training-instance registry and result files for the study. Release v2.0.1 has the same content as v2.0 (corrected CWRU loader, audit of the loading error, corrected-loader confirmation runs and post-hoc inference on the corrected weights) plus licence and archive metadata. Trained weights are attached to the GitHub releases v1.0 and v2.0 and can be checked with code/verify_weights.py against the SHA-256 values in the registry.
